create_client_openai: create an OpenAI client configured with the Hugging Face router base URL and HF_TOKEN
create_chat_completion: create a non-streaming chat completion using the OpenAI client with a conversational LLM model
read_completion_message: read the assistant message from the first choice of a chat completion response
configure_hf_inference_client: configure an OpenAI-compatible client to route requests through the Hugging Face inference router
send_user_message: send a user message to a conversational LLM via the OpenAI chat completions API and print the response
